exercises.name: BOSU Ball
techniqueNotes: Let the BOSU Ball curl your back on the way down
Curl up, segment by segment (head, then Upperback, then lowerback)
Breathe at the top of every rep if needed
Hook your feet with a heavy dumbbell

exercises.name: Cybex Chest Press
techniqueNotes: Wrists stacked with elbows
5 points of contact (head, upper back, butt, and 2 feet
Exhale on push
Inhale on down portion
Control the weight as you lower it

exercises.name: EGYM Back Row (Horizontal handle)
techniqueNotes: Drive the elbow wide and back, getting a squeeze with the shoulder blades
Set your hands up so that when you row and squeeze, your elbow/arm create about a 80-90 degree angle
Exhale as you pull
Control the weight on the way back
muscleVariants: Shoulders, Chest, Back, Biceps, Triceps, Core

exercises.name: EGYM Back Row (Vertical handle)
techniqueNotes: Drive the elbows down and low towards your hips
Don’t pass your torso as you pull
Exhale on the pull, inhale & control on the way back

exercises.name: EGYM Leg Curl
techniqueNotes: Point toes to your nose
Line up legs about shoulder width apart
Press yourself into the chair
Exhale as you curl back
Control the weight as it comes up

exercises.name: EGYM Leg Extension
techniqueNotes: Pull yourself into the chair with handles
Toes to nose (optional)
Exhale as you kick the legs up
Control the weight through full range of motion as you lower it

exercises.name: EGYM Squat
techniqueNotes: Feet shoulder width apart
Toes facing forward or just slightly to the side
Breathe in at the top, and brace core
Let your knees bend, and don’t push butt back too far
At the bottom, push up and exhale
Pick a spot to look at and keep neck neutral

exercises.name: Goblet Squats
techniqueNotes: Hold dumbbell like a flower at chest level
Get into a good squat stance
Control the weight down and then explode upwards with an exhale

exercises.name: Leg Curl
techniqueNotes: Push yourself into the chair using the handle in front.
Position the pad just above the ankles, behind the legs.
Exhale as you curl; inhale during the controlled return.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
techniqueNotes: Pull yourself into the chair using the handles.
Position the pad just above the ankles.
Exhale as you extend; breathe in while resisting the return.

exercises.name: Pallof Press w/ Rotation
techniqueNotes: Interlock hands and just core to rotate
Cable is held at chest center for 3s before rotating back

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
techniqueNotes: Start position: elbows lined with chest, and shoulder angled a bit downwards (keep arms tucked in towards body).
Keep most hand pressure through the thumb-side heel of your hand.
Keep wrists stacked with elbows and shoulders.
Exhale on the push; breathe in and control the lowering.

exercises.name: Single Leg Heel Raise
techniqueNotes: Push yourself tall through the balls of your feet (exhale)
Control your body down as your heel drops
exercises.settings: Elevated surface & something to help balance

exercises.name: Underhand Pull-Ups
techniqueNotes: Underhand grip
Drive elbows down into your pockets
Exhale as you pull up, inhale on the way down

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
techniqueNotes: Stand on chair if necessary.
Make sure the leg padding is set correctly.
Grab proper hand width on the bar before pulling down.
Pull down and back towards your back pockets.

exercises.name: Leg Press
techniqueNotes: About 90 degrees at the knee at the start.
Gently lock out, or skip the lockout.

exercises.name: Hip Abductor
techniqueNotes: Set the leg pads facing inwards.
Move them all the way to the middle.
Press your legs from in to out.

exercises.name: Hip Adductor
techniqueNotes: Set leg pads facing outwards.
Move the legs as far out as possible.
Press legs from out to in.
